programme: Connecting Health - Clinical Data Repository (CDR) and openEHR
response_deadline_basis: ProContract public opportunity listing; confirm against controlling tender pack before any response action
public_contract_term: 5 years with option to extend by up to 2 years

sources.authority: ProContract / Due North opportunity feed for States of Jersey

public_scope_facts: The procurement is for a centralised Clinical Data Repository and real-time data platform within Jersey's Connecting Health digital-transformation programme.
The requirement combines the Get Care Connected (IP2) and Get Smart (IP4) investment packages.
The successful supplier is expected to deliver a platform compliant with openEHR standards and architecture.
The public notice describes real-time access to clinical information and interoperability across health and care systems.
The solution is expected to support open standards, portability, supplier independence, and integration with existing Government of Jersey and healthcare technology environments.
Future analytics and digital capabilities are part of the stated outcome.
The buyer seeks a single supplier for the overall requirement while allowing joint bids, partnerships, and Special Purpose Vehicles where appropriate.
The anticipated public contract term is five years with an option to extend by up to two further years.
